introduction_markdown:
**Cameroon General Certificate of Education Board - General Certificate of Education Examination. Physics 2 (0780), ADVANCED LEVEL, June 2020. Time allowed: two and a half hours.**

Answer ALL questions. Section I is designed to be answered in 1 hour, Section II in 30 minutes and Section III in 1 hour. You are advised to divide your time accordingly. You are reminded of the necessity for good English and orderly presentation in your answers. In calculations you must show all the steps in your working, giving your answer at each stage. Calculators and formulae booklet are allowed.

**Structure of the paper.** SECTION I (One hour, answer all questions): questions 1 to 5 are compulsory; in question 6 answer EITHER 6 (a), (b) and (c) OR 6 (d), (e) and (f). SECTION II (30 minutes): DATA ANALYSIS, question 7. SECTION III (1 hour): OPTIONS - answer any two questions from the four options (Option 1: Energy resources and environmental physics, question 8; Option 2: Communication, question 9; Option 3: Electronics, question 10; Option 4: Medical physics, question 11).

No data sheet is printed in the paper: whenever a constant is needed, the model answer states the value it uses.
enonce_intro_markdown: Strontium-89 has a **half-life of 84 days** (underlined in the paper).
incertitudes: Question 5 : seul le total (5 marks) est imprimé. En (b), 21 jours = un quart de la demi-vie : l'activité à la préparation vaut 2^(1/4) fois l'activité mesurée. Le groupe souligné de l énoncé est rendu en gras.

questions.enonce_markdown: Explain the meaning of the underlined phrase.
questions.corrige_markdown: The **half-life** of strontium-89 is the **time taken for the activity of a sample** (equivalently, for the number of undecayed strontium-89 nuclei) **to fall to half of its value**. Here, any sample loses half of its activity every 84 days, whatever its starting activity: the decay is random for each nucleus but follows a fixed exponential law for a large number of nuclei.

questions.enonce_markdown: A laboratory prepares a strontium-89 source. 21 days after preparation, its activity is measured to be $7.4\times10^{6}\ \mathrm{Bq}$. What is the activity of the source at the time of preparation?
questions.corrige_markdown:
Decay constant: $\lambda = \dfrac{\ln 2}{t_{1/2}} = \dfrac{0.693}{84\ \mathrm{days}} = 8.25\times10^{-3}\ \mathrm{day^{-1}}$.

The activity follows $A = A_0 e^{-\lambda t}$, so
$$A_0 = A\,e^{\lambda t} = 7.4\times10^{6}\times e^{(8.25\times10^{-3}\times21)} = 7.4\times10^{6}\times e^{0.1733} = 7.4\times10^{6}\times1.189$$

**$A_0 = 8.8\times10^{6}\ \mathrm{Bq}$.**

Check: $21 = 84/4$ days is a quarter of a half-life, so $A = A_0\,2^{-1/4} = 0.841\,A_0$, giving $A_0 = 7.4\times10^{6}/0.841 = 8.8\times10^{6}\ \mathrm{Bq}$.
